title: Culture medium and culture method for Drechmeria coniospora ARSEF 6962
abstract: The invention relates to a culture method for quickly increasing the biomass of a nematode biological-control fungus Drechmeria coniospora ARSEF 6962 and shortening the spore production cycle. Drechmeria coniospora ARSEF 6962 is cultured at a room temperature with a solid medium in a culture dish. Animal kidney and/or liver are/is added into the solid medium so as to increase the biomass of the fungus and shorten the spore production cycle.
